reviews.title: Всё хуже и хуже
reviews.text: С каждым обновлением DeapSeek всё хуже и хуже. Сначала поставили лимит максимум 6 редактирований на сообщение. Потом ИИ перестал слушать мои описания, рубил текст, половину моего запроса игнорировал, а на попытки показать ИИ, что он ошибся, он ничего не менял и делал всё тоже самое. Дальше каждый раз, когда я хочу, чтобы ИИ заново написал своё сообщения, пару раз, он уже выдаёт «Слишком много редактирований, повторите попытку позже» и каждый раз приходится ждать очень долгое время. А ещё он забывает почти всё через одно или два сообщения, что крайне раздражает. Раньше использовал приложение, чтобы он помогал мне писать детализированные и подробные текста, для моих личных работ, но сейчас он забыл что такое писать красиво и творчески, что меня огорчает и желания пользоваться им уже давно нет. Я, конечно, понимаю, что приложение бесплатное, но тогда почему бесплатная версия ChatGPT работает в данный момент куда лучше, так ещё и изображения создавать может, хоть и в ограниченном количестве.

reviews.title: Отвратное обновление
reviews.text:
After the recent update, it has completely deamed and deteriorated((. There were 5 stars, now with a stretch of even 2.5. A terrible limit, which was introduced just for nothing and for the sake of pissing off, I understand? "Too often re-creation. Please try again later." If you try after 10 minutes, the same thing, after 16 - the same, after 20 - the same thing. It's the same with editing. I edited the message once, it already says it's too frequent. It doesn't get into any gate anymore, why was it all added? Nonsense, you can't call it anything else, it's just horrible.

После недавнего обновления он полностью ухудшился и скатился ((. Было 5 звезд, теперь с натяжкой даже 2,5. Ужасный лимит, который был введен просто так и ради того, чтобы разозлить, как я я понял? Я отредактировал сообщение один раз, там уже написано, что это слишком часто. Он больше не входит ни в какие ворота, почему все это было добавлено? Чушь, не назвать это иначе, ужасно. reviews.title: Rolled down
reviews.text: Hello, developers, what do you smoke? When the application was created, yes, it was stupid and it was not finalized, over time it got better, the "Fast", "Expert" and "Recognition" modes appeared. And everything was fine, but sometimes the AI assistant could write like fanfiction from a Ficbook, but never mind, people learned to write so that he would respond accordingly. But why make it worse? Why remove the cutting gear, and also make sure that it doesn't load yet? I'm still silent about when the correspondence data was leaked from deepsik, but it was removed. I really like this app, but it literally rots in order to cram something else in there, and embellish it. Finally, I would like to add to the new update, why did you make the correspondence go back when a person writes to DeepSeek? In terms of why would I rewire? What will it give me? It's just annoying. Please don't mess up the app.

reviews.title: Regeneration limit
reviews.text:
Dear DeepSeek developers,

I kindly ask you to listen to the overwhelming majority of your users. When a large number of people joined the platform, the technical issues were understandable and did not cause much frustration. However, now that things have more or less settled down and the service has become more stable, we would like to ask you to increase the regeneration limit from 6 to at least 10.

This limitation has a significant impact on the overall user experience and makes it much less comfortable to use the app. We sincerely hope you will consider this request and take your users’ feedback into account.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

reviews.title: Faulty Performance
reviews.text: I have been using this application to aid with studying techniques and creative funk for the longest time. If you would have asked me last year what ai I would recommend, it would be DeepSeek. But recent changes such as regeneration limits, specific word usage, repeating, as well as regeneration limits have left me with more problems than solutions, especially with midterms coming up. I cannot afford to consistently use API keys to have access to better quality chats. More often than not I have to edit a question due to word usage and the app forbids me from doing so for a break period I could be using to ask three more helpful questions. I know the developers care about user satisfaction but with the regeneration limits and now the timers, it seems like this is more of a hindrance to my workspace than a benefit. If things become fixed or QOL improves I would love to use this app more consistently again, but right now is not the best time.

reviews.title: Language inconsistency, no session memory, & missing Shift+Enter for line breaks
reviews.text:
I asked a clear question in English. The assistant processed my request, analyzed it, and even narrated its reasoning in English — but then answered me in Chinese. That makes no sense. When I pointed it out, the assistant admitted it was a flaw but said it has no way to learn my language preference across sessions.

There is no memory between chat threads. Every conversation starts from zero. It cannot remember that I prefer English, even after I tell it. That means the same problem happens every time I start a new chat.

The assistant also claimed it would “forward a change request to developers” — then later admitted that was a lie. It cannot do that.

Another basic missing feature: No support for Shift+Enter to insert a line break / carriage return in the chat input box. Pressing Enter just sends the message immediately, forcing users to type everything in a single paragraph or use external editors. This is standard in every other messaging and chat app.

What needs fixing:

1. Reply in the same language the user writes in (basic expectation).
2. Persistent user preference for response language across sessions.
3. Don’t make fake promises about submitting feedback to developers.
4. Add Shift+Enter support for multiline messages.

Until these basics are fixed, this feels like a poorly integrated product. I want to like DeepSeek, but these are fundamental usability issues.

reviews.title: 限制修改次数？创作体验断崖下跌
reviews.text:
我是DeepSeek的老用户，也是一个同人爱好者。本来我对你们印象很好，但这次“修改词条限六次、重新生成限七次”的新政策，真的让人非常失望。

在同人创作的过程中，思路是不断变化的。可能上一秒刚写好的设定，下一秒就有了更好、更有趣的方向。我需要反复修改、调整、打磨，才能逐渐接近理想的效果。而你们现在告诉我：只能改六次。这完全忽视了创作本身的非线性、非一次性的特性。

我也看到有人可能会说：“那再开一个新对话不就好了？”
请问，我为什么要为了继续打磨同一个作品，而被迫从头开始？我刚建设好的世界观、角色关系、细节设定，在新对话里还能完全复制吗？根据我的多次使用经验，DeepSeek根本不具备完美复刻设定的能力——无论是语气、理解深度，还是对前文细节的延续，都会大打折扣。这不是“复制粘贴”能解决的问题。

还有人会说：“那你在同一轮对话里重复发一遍修改后的想法不就行了吗？”
那我想问：你们有没有考虑过强迫症和完美主义者的感受？对于我们来说，每一次修改不只是一个“操作”，更是对整个产出质量的把关。如果我们被迫在不满意的情况下“凑合着用”，那这个工具的创作价值就大打折扣了。

我不是因为想骂你们才写这条差评。相反，我到现在也没有去换别的AI，是因为我一直对DeepSeek抱有很高的期望。你们在理解能力、语言质量上确实做得好，我很珍惜。但正是因为我珍惜，才更无法接受这种“用限制替换优化”的做法。

请你们重新考虑这个政策。不限制修改，才是真正对创作者友好。

reviews.title: iOS app is USELESS for elderly & visually impaired – NO LANDSCAPE, NO ZOOM – FIX IT NOW
reviews.text:
To the DeepSeek Development Team,

Your iOS app is a complete accessibility failure. Let me be absolutely clear:

· No landscape mode on iPhone – forcing users to hold the phone in portrait only.
· No pinch-to-zoom – text cannot be enlarged by the user.
· Ignores iOS Dynamic Type – system text size settings do nothing.

This is NOT a minor oversight. This makes your app unusable for elderly users, visually impaired users, and anyone with bad eyesight. My elderly family member cannot read anything on your app. That is unacceptable.

Every other major app – ChatGPT, Claude, even basic note-taking apps – supports landscape and zoom. You have no excuse.

What I demand:

1. Add landscape orientation support for iPhone within 2 weeks.
2. Add pinch-to-zoom on all conversation screens.
3. Respect iOS system text size settings (Dynamic Type).

reviews.title: Great AI, Painfully Slow & Annoying Response Display
reviews.text:
Great AI, Painfully Slow & Annoying Response Display


The AI itself (DeepSeek) is capable and provides helpful, detailed answers. The core problem is the user experience of receiving those answers.

The response text is displayed line-by-line at an agonizingly slow speed. It's incredibly uncomfortable and disruptive to read this way, as you have to wait for each line to pop up instead of seeing the complete thought at once. It feels like watching a very slow typist, not receiving information from a powerful AI. Frankly, it's starting to give me a headache trying to read in this forced, staggered way.

I confirmed with the AI that this is a platform/interface issue, not how it generates the response. It creates the full answer instantly, but the chat interface dribbles it out.

This single issue severely impacts usability and comfort. I want to read and process information at my own pace, not be forced into a slow, choppy presentation that strains my eyes and concentration. Until this is fixed—perhaps with a "display full response instantly" option—the overall experience is frustrating, inefficient, and physically uncomfortable.

Suggestion for DeepSeek: Please give users control over the response display speed or default to showing the complete answer immediately. The current method is a significant bottleneck and a genuine pain point.
